mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate falls below 2.5%.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines below 2.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >0.5% and UNRATE decreases by >0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1800 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1800 thousand units during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior quarter indicates robust manufacturing output, correlating with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 115.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 115.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) and drop in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days when both series fall below threshold values.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines by >0.3% and RSAFS declines by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110.0 after a contraction signals improving manufacturing conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rebounds above 110.0 during post-shock recovery.
